text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If I have any "regrets," there is only one.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...The Symboli family is a prestigious house whose name
is known to everyone in the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Among them, I was recognized for my talent
and raised under watchful, expectant eyes from a young age.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text: Sirius! Stay low, focus on your form! You can still push it, faster, faster!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! That's it!
Stay right on their tail, Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
Damn it! I was so close!"

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. You've gotten better, Sirius.
I can't afford to let my guard down anymore either.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Hehe...! 
Yeah, next time, I'll definitely be the one to win!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—I have two Trainers.
My old man, who's an active Trainer, and the team's teacher.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Both were rich in knowledge yet flexible,
and all of it was always there for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Your time has improved considerably!
I knew this routine was exactly what you needed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's refine your form! I heard some useful advice
from a club team trainer during a discussion the other day—

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
(...Dad and my teacher know everything.
Whatever judgment they make is always right.)

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
(If I follow them, I can't go wrong.
I'll become a stronger Umamusume than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —A cessation of thought, the end result of blind faith.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Punishment is always in store for such
foolish and blundering Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... *pant*, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"How... why...!
Why is the gap this huge...?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why?! I've been training so
hard, so why... Dammit!
—I did... everything you told me to...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "It's because you and Dad gave me terrible coaching!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The moment that comes to mind, you realize it.
Just how utterly foolish you've been."

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
...! No, no!
It's not the teachers' fault, it's mine!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
I left everything to Sensei and my father,
without putting in a shred of extra effort myself...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Just sitting around idly, waiting for scraps with your mouth wide open...!
There's no way you can get strong looking like that...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
—...Tch,
there's no way he could beat that guy...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right... She—
Rudolf always thinks and chooses for herself.
It's only natural the gap between us widens...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, dammit!
I'm never gonna make that same mistake again...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: I will decide everything regarding myself...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Abandoning thought, relinquishing your options—
I will never allow anything like that to happen again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No matter who it might be,
I won't allow myself to follow along blindly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "I shall seize it with these hands, carve my own path, and ascend to the singular summit...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Tomorrow marks the memorable first day of our run through the Twinkle Series. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Corner pocket.
—I win. Don't cry now, pup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I challenged her to a game of billiards with the day-one training menu on the line,
but I was completely defeated...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: So even giving you a massive handicap was useless. Makes me worry for your future, doesn't it? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she said so, she had improved since they first met.
It was just that Sirius Symboli was far too skilled.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, you really wanna make an even bigger fool of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: One match only. The winner gets the right to dictate the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you've forgotten the rules,
then you need some discipline, huh? Well?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you're so frustrated, hold that cue properly
and show me what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it was our first day... it was a rule the two of us agreed on, so it couldn't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Led by Sirius Symboli, I meekly headed back home. However—

text_block_list.name: Ruffian A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you've got money on ya, right? You Tracen Academy kids always do. Come on, jump!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment we stepped into the back alley, we were surrounded
by shady characters in hoods. Shielding Sirius Symboli,
I desperately searched for a way out.

text_block_list.name: Ruffian B
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, too scared to even make a sound? Pretty pathetic for a full-grown adult, ain't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She kicked up against the wall beside me,
looming close and intimidating me at point-blank range.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to at least let her escape,
I turned around and called out to her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What do you think you're doing, you guys?

text_block_list.name: Ruffian (?) A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, guess that's a no after all!
Damn it, cancel, cancel!

text_block_list.name: Ruffian (?) B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Prank failed! So on that note,
congratulations on kicking off your
Twinkle Series challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sign held up reading "Pranked!"
Party poppers bursting with a bang.
And beneath the hoods lowered one after another... were beaming smiles.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...They're all familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I instinctively crouched down,
Sirius Symboli smacked me on the head.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Sorry for surprising you!
I just really wanted to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-san, you're seriously gonna blow everyone away!
We're rooting for you super hard!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
I totally believe that you can reign supreme
at the very top of this country, Sirius-san~!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A nation? ...Hah, how soft.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You guys don't understand
the true meaning of the "summit."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I shall paint over every single glory born in this country.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, that's just a stepping stone.
Listen to the sound beyond the sea.
What we must aim for is—the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Wha— b-but! Even if you say the world, barely anyone goes overseas—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"So what? It's pathetic.
Acting all high and mighty in this cramped island nation means jack shit."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If there's no precedent, I'll carve one out myself.
Someday, I'll shine brilliantly at the very pinnacle of this world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No matter what stands in our way.
...There is nothing I cannot do. Right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaaaa...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you say you believe in me, don't give me half-baked platitudes.
Keep your eyes on me with that resolve in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she makes her proud declaration,
a powerful sparkle gleams in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Your answer?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Yessir!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one could remain unmoved by Sirius Symboli's
powerful, unwavering words and piercing gaze.
choice_data_list: (I want to see her make her dream come true!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without exception, I'm the same way.
Involuntarily, strength floods my clenched fists.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure she can run with full strength,
I will continue to support her with everything I have.
I reaffirmed that vow in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I can't hear your response.
What happened to that energetic "Woof"?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Good girl, see? You can do it when you try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My protest that I hadn't meant it as an agreement
was splendidly brushed aside—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Wanna try learning "shake" next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
though I found myself wrapped around her little finger at times—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blazing through domestic races,
eventually aiming for the top of the world...
Her days of beautiful challenges had begun.
